evidence.quote: Duration of the course / programme: 6 semesters
Description of selection and entrance examination process secondary school leaving certificate

notes: The tuition figure (EUR 4,000 per semester) comes from the institution's fees page and applies to Bachelor's degree programmes of The University of Buckingham at IBS; the programme's own page only links to that fees page, so the exact fee for this specialisation should be confirmed with IBS. Entrance requirements: secondary school leaving certificate; the exact level of English proficiency required is stated as IELTS 6.0 or equivalent (a specific CEFR level is not stated on the programme page), and an entrance examination is not required. Application deadline for the September 2026 intake is 30 September 2026 (with the note that IBS might consider late applications), but the page does not explicitly say this deadline is for non-EU/international applicants, so it is only a manual-check item.

evidence.quote: Admission criteria • Secondary school leaving certificate AND • IELTS 6.0 or equivalent*
* i.e.: TOEFL 72, GCSE English, Duolingo 105 etc.

note.fr: Vérifiez si la date limite de candidature indiquée sur la page (30 septembre 2026) s'applique à votre situation d'étudiant étranger, ou contactez info@ibsbudapest.com.
